meaning: independent, able to manage on your own

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being independent, including an independent candidate.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person, especially a child, who can act without relying on or being controlled by others.

exampleSentences.english: My son now knows how to take the bus home by himself; he is really autonomous.
